authorization.historicalPolicyV1: G2_M4_POLICY_v1.json stays byte-identical (its M4_B = NOT AUTHORIZED is the historical snapshot at M4.A); this v2 is the prospective authorization record for M4.B only

scope: direct linear-elastic material attribution of three perfectly bonded annuli on the frozen homogeneous S2 crack (s = 33.4 mm), original 76-chord ring boundaries, unchanged mesh, loads and boundary conditions; NO crack advance, NO trajectories, NO State 3, NO mixed per-ring moduli, NO interface fracture, NO CZM, NO physical onset/arrest claim

reference.state: S2 (original homogeneous WP3.4 chain, attempt 2, STEP_002)
forbiddenReferences: material-specific S2 crack geometries of PR #41

acceptedBaselines.note: run D of PR #38 (Issue #36), itself bitwise equal to PR #35 run C (outputs/g2_material_contrast_v1/run_20261119_003430_660)

rings.ordering: ascending y of the hole centre; ID 1 lower (nearest the initial crack), 2 middle, 3 upper
rings.inactiveRing: E = E_matrix, nu = nu_matrix; geometric boundary stays in the mesh; NOT a hole, NOT a debonded layer
rings.identitySource: PM.annulusOf of the qualified topological mapper g2_material_phase_map (ownerRing), cross-checked element by element by the independent chord half-plane oracle g2_m4b_ring_owner_oracle; no centroid-only selector
rings.assemblyLabel: phaseForAssembly(e) = 1 + (ownerRing(e) > 0 && mask(ownerRing(e))); mats(1) = matrix, mats(2) = active material; ownerRing is always retained as a separate field
rings.perfectBond: phases share T6 nodal DOFs (no duplication, no interface elements)

design.noneShared: the contrast-independent none solve (no element carries label 2; mats(2) = matrix) is computed once and serves both logical (0.5, none) and (2.0, none) cases
design.executionOrder: B2 baselines first (none, c0p5_111, c2p0_111 and two legacy reference solves of the full-band states); the remaining 12 subset cases only after every B2 gate passed
design.caseOutsideDesign: any other case id, contrast or mask is refused before any solve (HOLD_CASE_OUTSIDE_DESIGN); no retries, no 17th case, no 3^3 mixed assignment

B1_activation.ownerOracle: independent chord half-plane classification of all six T6 nodes of every element against each ring polygon and hole polygon; must equal annulusOf exactly; no straddling element; no node strictly inside a hole
activationVerifier: ringIdsAscendingY and one-to-one with interface polygons
per-ring element count and area equal polygon annulus area (rel 1e-12)
active area = sum of active ring areas
chord owners: inner owner ownerRing == h, outer owner ownerRing == 0, shared midside on chord (1e-9 mm)
active ring chords carry the material jump (2|1); passive ring chords carry none (1|1)
number of material-jump T3 edges == 76 x number of active rings
materials: mats(1) = matrix, mats(2) = c * matrix, same nu, SPD plane-stress D
q support and 15 mm tip guide free of ANY ring-owned element (stronger than phase-only), q clearance to the nearest ring node >= 1 mm
each ring connected, matrix connected, coincident nodes only registered crack twins
negativeControlsMustFail: node moved into a hole (void filling)
inactive ring given a material jump

B2_baselines.none_vs_H1: BITWISE equality with CASE_S2_H1 of u, EDI_all (5 annuli x [KI KII J]), EDI4x4, KI_COD, KII_COD, CMOD and compliance (the same assembly order as the qualified M0 identity, which was exactly zero); no fallback threshold; any difference = HOLD_BASELINE_REGRESSION
B2_baselines.all_vs_full_band: c = 0.5 and 2.0 with mask 111 must equal CASE_S2_Msoft / CASE_S2_Mstiff BITWISE in u, EDI_all, EDI4x4, KI_COD, KII_COD, J, compliance, CMOD, reactions, total and phase strain energy (the historical PR #35 / M2 regression used exact equality); the legacy g2_material_sif_on_mesh must PASS on both full-band states and equal the new routine bitwise
B2_baselines.phaseLabel: for mask 111 phaseForAssembly must equal PM.phase exactly

gates.inheritedSIFGates: G2_TRAJECTORY_POLICY_v1.json verification block, unchanged (equilibrium 1e-8, COD-EDI 0.03, contour spread 0.005, J identity 0.005, quadrature 0.001, whole-crack opening >= -1e-9 mm, KI > 0, conditional KII sign gate at |KII/KI| > 0.01, q support inside the core)

partialActivationGates.qSupportOwnerFree: every element with a node inside any q outer radius is matrix-owned (ownerRing == 0)
partialActivationGates.passiveRings: geometric conformity only (oracle, chords, midsides); their side-traction difference is reported as information and is NOT a gate; no two-material balance diagnostic is run on them
partialActivationGates.loadAndThickness: applied nodal force sum = -P / thickness at the load vertex only, thickness 12.7 mm, P = 1 N

observables.G: G = (K_I^2 + K_II^2) / E_matrix (plane stress), K from EDI 6x6 on q annulus 0.4-2.6 mm (primary), matrix material at the tip
observables.theta: theta_MTS = 2 atan2(-2 K_II, K_I + sqrt(K_I^2 + 8 K_II^2)) in the S2 terminal-segment frame, signed degrees; the global tangent angle is reported separately
observables.decomposition: f_i = F({i}); I_ij = F({i,j}) - f_i - f_j; I_123 = F({1,2,3}) - sum f_i - sum I_ij; reconstruction F({1,2,3}) = sum f_i + sum I_ij + I_123 must hold to 1e-12 (F_G) and 1e-10 deg (F_theta)
observables.shapley: three-player Shapley values (average marginal contribution over all six insertion orders), exact sum identity to F({1,2,3}); bookkeeping only, not evidence of independent action
observables.equalArea: 1-ring vs 1-ring and 2-ring vs 2-ring differences only; never 1 vs 3 as equal cost
alsoReported: signed K_I, K_II (EDI, COD, 4x4, five contours)
ring centre positions in the S2 tip frame
observables.notReported: R_total or R_path (no new paths); F_G is a direct material effect at fixed crack geometry

uncertainty.estimatorVariants: e in {EDI 6x6 on each of the four other registered q annuli, EDI 4x4 on 0.4-2.6 mm, blind bank COD 0.1-1.5 mm}
uncertainty.primaryPaired: for any quantity Q that is a fixed linear combination of the eight case values of F (or theta), Q_e is the same combination computed with variant e in EVERY case (so the common none baseline is correlated, as in U_R); U_Q = max_e |Q_e - Q|; resolved iff |Q| > 2 U_Q and sign(Q_COD) == sign(Q). For F_G(S) this is exactly the inherited U_R rule
uncertainty.conservativeUncorrelated_G: d_k = |G_EDI,k - G_COD,k| / G_EDI,k for every case k; for Q = sum_k a_k G_k / G_none + const: U_cons = sum_{k != none} |a_k| (G_k / G_none) d_k + |sum_{k != none} a_k G_k / G_none| d_none; for F_G(S) this equals the inherited R (d_S + d_none); resolved iff |Q| > U_cons and sign(Q_COD) == sign(Q)
uncertainty.conservativeUncorrelated_theta: e_k = |theta_COD,k - theta_EDI,k|; U_cons = sum_k |a_k| e_k over all case coefficients including none; resolved iff |Q| > U_cons
uncertainty.statement: about +/-3.5 % conservative uncertainty on G ratios is retained; numerically robust within the chosen verification criteria is NOT a physically established effect
uncertainty.meshRefinement: not studied in M4.B (frozen mesh by design); M4.A cross-family drift of R_direct (0.07-0.10 % of the effect) is cited, not re-measured

readings.additivity: ADDITIVE_WITHIN_PRIMARY if no I_ij and no I_123 is resolved under the primary rule, otherwise NONADDITIVE_PRIMARY with the resolved terms listed; the conservative verdict is reported alongside
readings.ranking: rings ordered by f_i only where the pairwise 1-ring differences are resolved; otherwise reported as unresolved ties
readings.hypotheses: H1 (unequal ring influence), H2 (G order differs from theta order), H3 (nonzero I_ij or I_123) of the Ukrainian design document; null outcomes are admissible

resources.solverOrder: fixed T6 assembly of g2_t6_elasticity_phase (unchanged), backslash on K(free,free)
